title: MoReBench: Evaluating Procedural and Pluralistic Moral Reasoning in Language Models, More Than Outcomes
reasoning: The paper introduces MoReBench and MoReBench-Theory, which are specifically designed to evaluate and benchmark moral reasoning in LLMs. It focuses on five major ethical frameworks (Kantian Deontology, Benthamite Act Utilitarianism, Aristotelian Virtue Ethics, Scanlonian Contractualism, and Gauthierian Contractarianism) to assess how models navigate moral dilemmas and pluralistic values.
